proposition.statement_en: Two reports connect the verse with Quraysh speakers who disparaged Muhammad during the Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf episode; they do not simply identify Ka'b himself as the hostile referent.
proposition.supporting_span: حدثنا ابن المثنى, قال: ثنا عبد الوهاب, قال: ثنا داود, عن عكرمة, في هذه الآية:  أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيبًا مِنَ الْكِتَابِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ وَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هَؤُلاءِ أَهْدَى مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا سَبِيلا  قال: نـزلت في كعب بن الأشرف, أتى مكة فقال لها أهلها: نحن خير أم هذا الصنبور (9) المنبتر من قومه, ونحن أهل الحجيج, وعندنا منحر البدن, قال: أنتم خير. فأنـزل الله فيه هذه الآية, وأنـزل في الذين قالوا للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ما قالوا: ( إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الأبْتَرُ ) .

evidence_units.content_summary: The report connects the passage quoted from 4:51 with Ka'b's visit to Mecca and his answer favoring its inhabitants. It separately associates 108:3 with those who spoke disparagingly about Muhammad.

source_locator.arabic: حدثنا ابن المثنى, قال: ثنا عبد الوهاب, قال: ثنا داود, عن عكرمة, في هذه الآية:  أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيبًا مِنَ الْكِتَابِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ وَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هَؤُلاءِ أَهْدَى مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا سَبِيلا  قال: نـزلت في كعب بن الأشرف, أتى مكة فقال لها أهلها: نحن خير أم هذا الصنبور (9) المنبتر من قومه, ونحن أهل الحجيج, وعندنا منحر البدن, قال: أنتم خير. فأنـزل الله فيه هذه الآية, وأنـزل في الذين قالوا للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ما قالوا: ( إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الأبْتَرُ ) .

evidence_units.content_summary: Meccan speakers cite their watering and sanctuary custodial roles, ask Ka'b to compare them with Muhammad, and receive a favorable answer. The report then associates the episode with 108:3 and a passage beginning at 4:51.

source_locator.arabic: حدثنا ابن بشار, قال: ثنا ابن أبى عديّ, قال: أنبأنا داود بن أبي هند, عن عكرمة, عن ابن عباس قال: لما قَدِم كعب بن الأشرف مكة أتَوْه, فقالوا له: نحن أهل السقاية والسدانة, وأنت سيد أهل المدينة, فنحن خير أم هذا الصنبور المنبتر من قومه, يزعم أنه خير منا؟ قال: بل أنتم خير منه, فنـزلت عليه: ( إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الأبْتَرُ ) قال: وأنـزلت عليه:  أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيبًا مِنَ الْكِتَابِ  ... إلى قوله  نَصِيرًا  .

links.semantic_link_note: Supports the reported Quraysh episode association; does not establish historical certainty, independent corroboration, Ka'b as sole hostile referent, or Tabari's exclusive preference.

staging_reference_policy: staging_key and *_ref are local symbolic references, not database columns. Remove and resolve only through a reviewed authorized workflow. Claim type43 is resolved; symbolic cross-references and review-only source locators still make this document non-executable.

schema_basis.claim_type_reason: 43 identification: reports the contextual identity of unnamed hostile speakers in 108:3; does not assert the episode as independently verified history.

fidelity.reporter_and_speaker: Ikrima and Ibn Abbas are report authorities. Ka'b is a participant consulted by Meccan speakers; do not promote him to the sole hostile referent.
fidelity.first_report_scope: The report distinguishes a cited passage about Ka'b from 108:3 applied to those who spoke disparagingly about Muhammad.
fidelity.second_report_scope: The account quotes the speakers' question and Ka'b's answer, then associates the episode with 108:3 and another Quranic passage. Preserve narrative speakers separately from the Ibn Abbas report attribution.
fidelity.disagreement: Keep this Quraysh episode distinct from al-As, Uqba and Tabari's universal application.

excluded_report.reason: Intervening Ikrima report lacks the explicit Ka'b episode; do not silently merge it into these two episode-specific reports.

fidelity.route_identity: Preserve abbreviated داود in the first route as written; do not normalize it to the longer name in the second route without evidence.

route_policy.reason: Both chains name Ikrima; the first abbreviates Dawud while the second spells out Dawud ibn Abi Hind. Shared naming does not justify independent corroboration or an unproved identity expansion.
route_policy.voice_rule: Keep report authorities distinct from quoted Meccan speakers and Ka'b. Tabari reports these accounts; do not encode them as his exclusive identification.
